<style>

        font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif !important;
    }

        border: 1.5px solid #009AD9 !important;
        border-radius: 14px !important;
        padding: 6px !important;
        margin: 12px !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }

    body.nr-dashboard-theme .masonry-container {
        column-gap: 30px !important;
        padding: 16px !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;

        padding: 0 12px !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }

    /* PRES KARTI */
body.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel>div {
background: #ffffff !important;
border-radius: 7px !important;
border: 2px solid #009AD9 !important;
margin: 0 !important;
padding: 16px !important;
box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) !important;
transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

    border: 4px solid #16a34a !important;
    animation: pres-border-yesil 2s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}

body.nr-dashboard-theme ui-card-panel.pres-durdu>div {
    border: 4px solid #e53e3e !important;
    animation: pres-border-kirmizi 1s ease-in-out infinite !important;
}

@keyframes pres-border-yesil {
    0%   { border-color: #16a34a !important; }
    50%  { border-color: #86efac !important; }
    100% { border-color: #16a34a !important; }
}

    50%  { border-color: #fca5a5 !important; }

        border: none !important;

        background-image: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
        outline: none !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
    }

    body.nr-dashboard-theme md-input-container {
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
    }

    body.nr-dashboard-theme md-input-container .md-input {
        border: none !important;
        border-bottom: none !important;
        background-image: none !important;
        box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    body.nr-dashboard-theme md-select-value {
        min-height: 0 !important;
        height: auto !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: flex-end !important;
    }

    body.nr-dashboard-theme .md-select-placeholder {
        color: #94a3b8 !important;
        font-size: 17px !important;
        font-weight: 500 !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
    }

    /* BUTON */
    body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-button button {
        font-size: 15px !important;
        font-weight: 600 !important;
        border-radius: 10px !important;
    }

    /* MD-CARD */
    body.nr-dashboard-theme md-card {
        margin: 4px 0 !important;
    }

    /* DURUM BORDERLARI */
    body.nr-dashboard-theme .border-aktif {
        border: 4px solid #22c55e !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3) !important;
    }

    body.nr-dashboard-theme .border-durdu {
        border: 4px solid #f43f5e !important;
        animation: card-alert 1.5s infinite !important;
    }

    @keyframes card-alert {
        0% {
            border-color: #f43f5e;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
        }

        50% {
            border-color: #ffffff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.6);
        }

        100% {
            border-color: #f43f5e;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
        }
    }

/* ===== SOL MENÜ ===== */
body.nr-dashboard-theme .md-sidenav-left {
background: #0094CE !important;
}
